name: The Lost Fragments
summary: Behind Theldurin, furious elementals fight over scraps of the Scroll of Myzrael. You gather the torn pieces while he fears what its magic might do.

sections.title: A Dangerous Parchment
sections.body: Theldurin the Lost fears the Scroll of Myzrael could draw Myzrael up to the surface. Then he considers another danger. She may already be free, or gathering strength to strike. If so, the scroll may be what you need to bind her again.

sections.title: Torn by the Elements
sections.body: Furious elementals took the scroll and tore it apart. Now they fight over its scraps in the hills behind Theldurin. Bring back three pieces: one torn, one crumpled and one singed. Theldurin hopes to mend them.

faq.q: Who sends you to collect the scroll fragments?
faq.answer: Theldurin the Lost asks you to bring back pieces of the destroyed scroll.

faq.q: What is the Scroll of Myzrael supposed to do?
faq.answer: Theldurin says the scroll’s magic could draw Myzrael up to the surface. If she is already free, he thinks it may be what you need to bind her again.

aliases: where to find the scroll pieces
faq.answer: Furious elementals took the scroll, tore it apart and now fight over the scraps in the hills behind Theldurin.
It follows your earlier dealings with Theldurin the Lost.
